义项: 名词 系统的学术探讨（scholarly essays 学术随笔）
名词 (引申义) 奖学金（a scholarship to study abroad 出国留学奖学金）

例句.英文: In combining elements of a mixtape album with scholarly essays that connect Carson's lyrics to historical and contemporary contexts for listeners both inside and outside academia, Carson's album helped redefine how scholarship is created and shared.
例句.中文: 把混音带专辑的要素与学术随笔结合起来，把卡森的歌词与听众身内身外的历史及当代语境相连。

例句.英文: Timbuktu was a center of trade and scholarship in the Sahara desert.
例句.中文: 廷巴克图曾是撒哈拉沙漠中的贸易与学术中心。

义项: 名词 同一物种内遗传上有差异的群体（the US and Japanese strains 美国与日本的品系）
名词 (引申义) 压力、紧张（under strain 处于压力之下）；动词「拉紧、扭伤」

例句.英文: Scientists aren’t entirely sure why C. geaster is distributed in this way (genetic analysis reveals that the US and Japanese strains diverged 19 million years ago), but the mushroom appears to be very selective: it is typically found on the decaying stumps and roots of only a few tree species that are abundant in these areas.
例句.中文: 科学家并不完全清楚 C. geaster 为何如此分布（基因分析显示，美国与日本的品系在 1900 万年前分化），但……

例句.英文: Distinct strains of microhistory emerged at different times in Italy, Iceland, and elsewhere, for example, and while microhistories of the 1980s reflected the era’s interest in labor history, the “global turn” in recent historiography sparked a wave of globally contextualized microhistories.
例句.中文: 例如，各不相同的微观史学脉络在不同时期出现于意大利、冰岛等地：1980 年代的微观史反映了那个时代对劳工史的兴趣，而近年史学的「全球转向」则掀起了一波全球语境化的微观史。

义项: 名词 研究或操作的标准程序（sampling protocols 采样规程）
名词 (引申义) 礼仪、外交礼节；计算机通信协议

例句.英文: The spatial distribution of isotopes within individual bodies of water is not always homogenous, potentially compromising studies with inadequate sampling protocols.
例句.中文: 各水体内部同位素的空间分布并不总是均匀的，这可能使采样规程不完善的研究结论受到削弱。

义项: 形容词 某地原生的（Indigenous art 土著艺术）
[辨析] 与 native 近义，但 indigenous 更常用于族群与物种的原生性表述

例句.英文: The compositional strategy of Untitled, a 1955 work by Cherokee artist Edna Massey, is far more closely aligned with Abstract Expressionism—a mid-twentieth-century school of painting dominated by European American artists—than with traditionally abstract forms of Indigenous art, such as beadwork.
例句.中文: 切罗基艺术家 Edna Massey 1955 年的作品《无题》，其构图策略与抽象表现主义更为接近，而非与土著艺术中传统的非具象形式接近。

例句.英文: Both centers contrast with museums that aren't Indigenous--led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non--Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.
例句.中文: 这两座中心与非原住民主导的博物馆形成对照：后者展出原住民器物时，预设的主要是非原住民观众，并依赖欧洲中心的展览设计策略。

义项: 名词 被广泛崇拜或效仿的对象（country icons 乡村音乐偶像）
名词 圣像；图标（click the icon 点击图标）

例句.英文: In some works, Villasana focuses on celebrating cultural icons who are people of color, as she does in her depiction of musician and composer Nina Simone.
例句.中文: 调幅电台帮助乡村音乐成为风靡全国的热潮，并使卡特·卡什等乡村偶像成为家喻户晓的名字。

例句.英文: The style's inclusivity has been encouraged—excessively so, many fans say—by the music-streaming service Spotify, whose popular playlist of hyperpop songs balances core figures with distinct outliers, like 1980s icon Kate Bush.

义项: 形容词 把各类人或事物都容纳在内（more inclusive than earlier anthologies 收录比早期选集更全、更包容）
形容词 inclusivity /ˌɪnkluːˈsɪvəti/ n. 包容性 —— The style's inclusivity（这种风格的包容性），文化 / 社会议论语篇的高频抽象名词
形容词 include（包含）→ inclusion（纳入、包含；真题另见 18 次）→ inclusive / inclusivity（包容的 / 包容性）；inclusion 属 include 的透明派生，不单独立条，读到按「纳入」理解即可
搭配说明: inclusivity — 抽象名词「包容性」；与 905 icon 共用同一真题句，背本条即复盘 icon
inclusion — include 的派生名词「纳入、包含」· 真题另见 18 次（the inclusion of… / for inclusion in…）

例句.英文: The style's inclusivity has been encouraged—excessively so, many fans say—by the music-streaming service Spotify, whose popular playlist of hyperpop songs balances core figures with distinct outliers, like 1980s icon Kate Bush.
例句.中文: 这种风格的包容性受到了——许多乐迷认为过了头——音乐流媒体平台 Spotify 的助推：其热门超流行歌单既容纳核心人物，也容纳像 1980 年代偶像凯特·布什这样的特立独行者。——与 905 icon 同句，可顺带复盘。

例句.英文: It suggests that, because they are relatively up to date, more recently published collections of cyberpunk stories are likely to be more inclusive than earlier anthologies.
例句.中文: 它提示：由于相对时新，较晚出版的赛博朋克小说集很可能比早期选集更具包容性。

义项: 动词 作品首次公演（premiered on Broadway 在百老汇首演）
[辨析] 与 premier（首相；首要的）拼写相近，注意区分

例句.英文: A revised version of the musical premiered on Broadway in 2019, in a larger production.
例句.中文: 该音乐剧的修订版于 2019 年在百老汇首演，制作规模更大。

例句.英文: Choreographers George Balanchine and Martha Graham both contributed sections to the dance piece Episodes, which premiered at New York’s City Center of Music and Drama in 1959.
例句.中文: 编舞家乔治·巴兰钦与玛莎·格雷厄姆共同为舞作《插曲》贡献了段落，该作 1959 年首演于纽约市音乐戏剧中心。

义项: 名词 值得惊叹的事物（the Marvel Cinematic Universe 漫威电影宇宙）
动词 惊叹、惊异（marvel at 对…感到惊叹）

例句.英文: Take, for instance, Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), which is part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe franchise.
例句.中文: 以 2019 年的《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》为例，它属于漫威电影宇宙系列。

例句.英文: It's true that this movie resembles earlier Marvel movies.
例句.中文: 的确，这部电影与早先的漫威电影相似。

义项: 名词 引起公愤的不道德或违法事件（the Watergate political scandal 水门政治丑闻）
名词 (引申义) 耻辱、公愤（a scandal to the family 家族的耻辱）

例句.英文: President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal …
例句.中文: 理查德·尼克松总统最著名的，是他卷入 1970 年代的水门政治丑闻——一桩牵涉阴谋、罪行与道德沦丧的复杂故事。

义项: 名词 艺术作品的类别（an art house genre 一种艺术电影类型）
[辨析] 与 category 相比，genre 专用于文艺作品分类

例句.英文: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (2010) and other films by Thai director Apichatpong Weerasethakul are contributions to slow cinema, an art house genre whose contemplative pacing and deprivileging of narrative are further exemplified by films such as Andrei Tarkovsky's Solaris (1972).
例句.中文: 《能召回前世的布米叔叔》（2010）等泰国导演阿彼察邦·韦拉斯哈古的影片，属于「慢电影」——一种节奏缓慢、注重氛围的艺术电影类型。

例句.英文: In a recent study, Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues allowed participants to listen to (and adjust the volume of) recordings of music in popular genres like heavy metal and acoustic folk, as well as recordings of nature sounds.
例句.中文: 在最近的一项研究中，Antonia Olivia Dolan 及同事让参与者聆听（并调节音量）流行类型音乐的录音（如重金属与原声民谣），以及自然声音的录音。

义项: 形容词 与殖民地统治相关的（colonial rule 殖民统治）
[词族] colony 殖民地；colonize 殖民；colonialism 殖民主义

例句.英文: Scholars cite Pedro Páramo, the 1955 novel by Mexican author Juan Rulfo, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.
例句.中文: 学者们把墨西哥作家胡安·鲁尔福 1955 年的小说《佩德罗·巴拉莫》视为魔幻现实主义的奠基之作——这种拉美小说风格在叙事中让超自然事件显得平常。

例句.英文: It included a model of Gehry House, a 1978‒88 project by US architect Frank Gehry featuring jagged geometric forms extending from a Dutch colonial exterior..
例句.中文: 展品中包括「盖里自宅」的模型——美国建筑师弗兰克·盖里 1978-88 年的项目，以从荷兰殖民风格外立面上斜逸而出的几何体块著称。

义项: 名词 由两种以上元素化合而成的物质（organic compounds 有机化合物）
形容词 /ˈkɒmpaʊnd/ 复合的（a compound sentence 复合句）；动词 /kəmˈpaʊnd/ 使加剧

例句.英文: Percent of Leaf Area Consumed by Hornworms After 90 Minutes 12 11 109 87654321 ? leaf area consumed 0· 2 3 1 Trial □ emitting leaves ■ nonemitting leaves Some plants'leaves emit a chemical compound (2- methyl-1,3-butadiene) that is thought to be a defense against insects.
例句.中文: （图表：喂食 90 分钟后天蚕蛾幼虫啃食叶面积百分比）有些植物的叶片会释放一种化学化合物（2-甲基-1,3-丁二烯），被认为是对付昆虫的一种防御机制。

例句.英文: Researchers modified leaves of the same plant species so that some emitted the compound and others didn’t, then placed hornworms—leaf-eating insects—between leaves of both types and allowed the hornworms to feed for 90 minutes.
例句.中文: 研究者改造同一植物物种的叶片，使一些散发该化合物、另一些不散发，然后把天蛾——食叶昆虫——放在两类叶片之间，任其取食 90 分钟。

义项: 动词 ossified authorities 僵化的权威——徒具历史地位、不再产生活力的对象；制度 / 惯例僵化亦用此词
动词 医学术语：软组织转变为骨组织（os- 骨 + -ify 化，同源 osteoporosis 骨质疏松）
[辨析] 近义 fossilize（化石→僵化，构词逻辑如出一辙）；反义 stay fluid / keep evolving
搭配说明: ossified — 过去分词作定语：ossified authorities）
ossification — 名词 · 僵化（社会学语境常见 the ossification of bureaucracy）
interlocutor — 同句复盘 · 419 interlocutor 与本词条共用同一哲学研究真题句：vital interlocutors（活跃的对话者）vs ossified authorities（僵化的权威）——一组对比

例句.英文: While both approaches engage with influential figures, those who do philosophy treat such figures as vital interlocutors who facilitate new insights rather than as ossified authorities who, though relevant to the present, primarily represent the discipline's past.
例句.中文: 两种进路都要与权威人物打交道，但「做哲学」的人把这些人物当作能激发新洞见的活跃对话者，而非徒然代表学科过往的僵化（ossified）权威——他们虽与当下相关，主要却只承载学科的历史。

义项: 名词 通过感官获取并解释信息的过程（perception of risk 风险感知）
名词 (引申义) 看法、观念（public perception 公众观感）

例句.英文: Rows in table may not add up to 100 due to rounding. Georgia Tech roboticists De’Aira Bryant and Ayanna Howard, along with ethicist Jason Borenstein, were interested in people’s perceptions of robots’ competence.
例句.中文: 佐治亚理工学院的机器人学者 De'Aira Bryant 与 Ayanna Howard，以及伦理学者 Jason Borenstein，想了解人们对机器人「胜任力」的看法。

例句.英文: Neuroscientist Artin Arshamian and his team sought to determine what affects a person’s perception of an odor as pleasant: is it culture, personal taste, or aspects of human anatomy?
例句.中文: 神经科学家 Artin Arshamian 及团队试图确定：影响一个人觉得气味宜人的因素究竟是文化、个人口味，还是人体构造？

义项: 形容词 指中心城市及其周边通勤区（the larger metropolitan area 更大的都会区）
[辨析] metropolitan area 都会区 ≠ city proper 市区本体

例句.英文: Often, governments will report a value for the city proper (including only residents within the city limits) and another for the larger metropolitan area (including residents from nearby places beyond the city limits).
例句.中文: 政府往往会同时报告「市区本体」（仅含市界内居民）与「更大都会区」（含市界外居民）两个数值。

例句.英文: Through the Urban Wildlife Information Network, citizen scientists systematically document animals they observe in metropolitan areas.
例句.中文: 通过「城市野生动物信息网络」，公民科学家系统地记录他们在都会区观察到的动物。

义项: 形容词 一个接一个、中间不间断（consecutive pulses 连续的脉冲）
[辨析] 与 successive 近义，但 consecutive 更强调「无间隔」

例句.英文: The time between consecutive pulses of an RRAT is referred to as a period.
例句.中文: 旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）相邻两次脉冲之间的时间被称为一个周期。

义项: 名词 与散文相对的韵文体（fugitive verse 应景诗、佚诗）
名词 (引申义) （歌曲的）主歌段落；《圣经》中的「节」

例句.英文: Though poems that became fugitive verse were typical of newspaper poetry of their era in their reliance on such elements as simple rhyme schemes and everyday settings, the phenomenon of fugitive verse represents a significant departure from the dominant model of literary authorship in which a work is controlled by a single and publicly identified author.
例句.中文: 这类应景诗在依赖简单韵式与日常题材上与同代报纸诗歌相似，但……

例句.英文: Whitmore, published in the Chicago Evening Post in 1878, exemplifies the phenomenon of “fugitive verse,” poems reprinted in newspapers and other nineteenth-century US periodicals without authorial oversight or even, in many cases, knowledge.
例句.中文: Whitmore 1878 年发表于《芝加哥晚报》的这首诗，是「 fugitive verse（转瞬诗）」现象的例证——未经作者监督、甚至在许多情况下不为作者所知，就在报刊及其他十九世纪美国期刊上转载的诗歌。

义项: 名词 对发明享有的排他性法律权利（Edison's patent for a vote recorder 爱迪生的投票记录器专利）
形容词 /ˈpeɪtnt/ 明显的（a patent error 明显的错误）

例句.英文: The book covers important parts of its subject's life, including Edison's patent for a vote recorder, his creation of a carbon-filament electric light bulb, and his development of a rechargeable battery.
例句.中文: 这本书涵盖了传主一生的重要部分，包括爱迪生的投票记录器专利、碳丝电灯泡的发明，以及他开发的……

例句.英文: In 1903, Mary Anderson patented a device that cleared rain and snow from a car’s windshield, improving visibility for drivers.
例句.中文: 1903 年，玛丽·安德森为一项清除汽车挡风玻璃上雨雪的装置取得专利，改善了驾驶员的视野。

义项: 动词 使完美或完整受到损害（marred by 因…而受损）
[辨析] 常用于被动 marred，语气比 damage 更强调「破坏其美好」

例句.英文: It first appears in the novel The Sands of Mars by English author Arthur C.
例句.中文: 但也许正因如此，整座宅邸那股彻底的教士气派反倒有所减损。

义项: 名词 关于行为对错的规范体系（eroded ethics 沦丧的道德）
[辨析] ethics 作「伦理学」为不可数；作「职业道德规范」常用复数

例句.英文: … a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as security operative Jack Caulfield and Attorney General John Mitchell.
例句.中文: 水门事件是一桩牵涉阴谋、罪行与道德沦丧的复杂故事。

义项: 名词 对事件或作品的阐释与评价（a commentary on constraint 对约束的评论）
名词 (引申义) （体育等的）实况解说

例句.英文: The work is manifestly a commentary on constraint, but many critics focus on Valdez and the social constraints women faced at the time, which is understandable but leaves the presence of Valdez's male collaborator Sandoval unexplained.
例句.中文: 这件作品显然是对「约束」的一则评论，但许多批评者把焦点放在 Valdez 以及当时女性所面临的种种社会约束上。

例句.英文: Rather than being an arbitrary stylistic choice, hyperpop's persistent modification of the voice functions as a commentary on how digital technology mediates human experience to day.
例句.中文: 超流行乐对声音的持续改造并非随意的风格选择，而是对数字技术如何中介当代人类经验的一种评注。

义项: 名词 对未来或假设情境的描述（a workplace scenario 一个职场情境）
[辨析] 与 situation 相比，scenario 更强调「假设性的整条情节线」

例句.英文: All the participants then described how they would respond to a workplace scenario.
例句.中文: 随后，所有参与者都描述了他们会如何应对某个职场情境。

例句.英文: A student reviews the findings and suggests that in the given scenario, those countries could meet the demand with solar energy alone but not with wind alone.
例句.中文: 一位学生审视这些发现后提出：在给定情境下，这些国家仅靠太阳能即可满足需求，仅靠风能则不能。

义项: 名词 金属铸币（a one-dollar coin 一美元硬币）
动词 创造（新词）（coin a term 造一个说法）

例句.英文: Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage—the profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it—for Singapore’s government, which in turn can be used to fund such services as transportation.
例句.中文: 发行一美元硬币可产生正值的铸币税——即硬币面值超过其生产成本时所产生的收益。

义项: 名词 官方对人口的系统统计（the US Census Bureau 美国人口普查局）
名词 (引申义) （某一群体的）清点、统计

例句.英文: Northeastern North Carolina’s Camden County is among the most rural counties in the United States: the US Census Bureau classified it as 99.5% rural in 2010.
例句.中文: 北卡罗来纳州东北部的卡姆登县是美国最乡村化的县之一：美国人口普查局在 2010 年将其认定为 99.5% 乡村。

义项: 动词 把计划付诸实践（implement a policy 实施政策）
名词 /ˈɪmplɪmənt/ 工具、器具（farm implements 农具）

例句.英文: Kwaxsistalla Wathl’thla, a song keeper for the Kwakwaka'wakw people in Canada, collaborated with ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al., sharing songs referencing terraced intertidal clam gardens the people implemented in the past to foster healthy development of a dietary staple.
例句.中文: 加拿大夸夸嘉夸族的歌者 Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla 与民族生物学家 Dana Lepofsky 等人合作，分享了提及梯田式……的歌曲。

例句.英文: Researchers Naoki Aizawa and Ami Ko collected data about the years in which various US states implemented RSRs.
例句.中文: 研究者 Naoki Aizawa 与 Ami Ko 收集了美国各州颁布费率稳定条款（RSR）年份的数据。

义项: 名词 公共运输系统（a transit stop 公交站点）
名词 (引申义) 通行、过境（in transit 在运输途中）

例句.英文: Experts hypothesize that since people might have more or less willingness to walk a given distance today than residents did ten years ago, placing the new stop based only on the older survey might result in an unsuccessful transit route.
例句.中文: 专家推测，由于今天的人步行某段距离的意愿可能与十年前的居民不同，仅依据……来设置新站点可能并不合适。

例句.英文: The team also looked at studies showing that people's willingness to walk to public transit is influenced by factors like weather and the presence of paved sidewalks and available crosswalks.
例句.中文: 团队还考察了这样的研究：人们步行搭乘公共交通的意愿受天气、铺装人行道与过街通道之有无等因素影响。

义项: 名词 人们赖以谋生的工作类别（various occupations 各类职业）
名词 (引申义) 占领、占用（military occupation 军事占领）

例句.英文: They recruited participants and asked them how likely they think it is that a robot could do the work required in various occupations.
例句.中文: 他们招募参与者，询问参与者认为机器人在各类职业中完成所需工作的可能性有多大。

例句.英文: The poems portray Aztec society before the occupation of the empire by the army of Spain, and marginal notes in Cantares Mexicanos indicate that much of the collection’s content predates the initial invasion.
例句.中文: 这些诗歌描绘西班牙军队占领帝国之前的阿兹特克社会；《墨西哥歌谣集》的页边批注表明，集中大部分内容的年代早于初次入侵。

义项: 形容词 缺乏防护而易受攻击（vulnerable to predators 易受捕食者侵害）
[辨析] be vulnerable to sth 易受…影响；名词 vulnerability 脆弱性

例句.英文: Researching this behavior, the students learned that this phenomenon is commonly referred to as "broken-wing display" and is meant to lure predators away from the nesting site and toward a seemingly vulnerable adult bird.
例句.中文: 学生们在研究这一行为时了解到，该现象通常被称为「折翼表演」，目的在于把捕食者引离筑巢地。

例句.英文: Many of these vulnerable plant species rely on the activity of fruit-eating birds to help spread the plants’ seeds in the wild.
例句.中文: 这些脆弱的植物物种，有许多依赖食果鸟类在野外帮助散播种子。

义项: 名词 曾在军队服役的人（military veterans 退伍军人）
名词 (引申义) 资深者（a veteran journalist 资深记者）

例句.英文: Since the nation’s earliest days, both houses of the United States Congress have counted many military veterans among their elected officials, including Hiram L.
例句.中文: 自建国之初，美国国会两院中就曾有许多退伍军人担任民选官员。

例句.英文: The veteran actor has performed in everything from commercials to Broadway musicals, but he is most known for his voice acting.
例句.中文: 这位资深演员从广告到百老汇音乐剧无所不演，但最广为人知的还是他的配音工作。

义项: 形容词 符合法律或公认准则的（its legitimate authority 其正当的权威依据）
形容词 (引申义) 合理的、有道理的（a legitimate concern 合理的担忧）

例句.英文: If I judge right, ’tis the duty of an historian to set everything in its own light, and to convey matter of fact upon its legitimate authority, and no other: I mean thus, (for I would be as explicit as I can) that where a story is vouched to him with sufficient authority, he ought to give the world the special testimonial of its proper voucher, or else he is not just to the story: and where it comes without such sufficient authority, he ought to say so; otherwise he is not just to himself.
例句.中文: 依我判断，史学家的职责是把每件事都放在它自身的光线下呈现，依据其正当的权威依据来陈述事实，而非其他。

义项: 名词 出于兴趣而非职业从事某事者（amateur science enthusiasts 业余科学爱好者）
形容词 (引申义) 业余的、不熟练的（an amateur performance 业余水平的表演）

例句.英文: In a large community science effort, biologist Grace Herzel and colleagues collaborated with hundreds of students and other amateur science enthusiasts for more than three years to study how butterfly color and weather conditions relate to butterfly behavior.
例句.中文: 在一项大型社区科学项目中，生物学家 Grace Herzel 及其同事与数百名学生及其他业余科学爱好者合作了三年多。

例句.英文: An amateur astronomer claims that she likely could see most, but not all, of the stars in the table while using a telescope with a 160-millimeter (mm) aperture.
例句.中文: 一位业余天文学家声称：使用口径 160 毫米的望远镜，她大概能看到表中大部分——但非全部——的恒星。

义项: 名词 能流动的物质（fluid could have reached the debris 流体可能到达过这些碎屑）
形容词 (引申义) 易变的、流畅的（a fluid situation 变化不定的局势）

例句.英文: The researchers assert that fluid could have reached the debris through the microfractures and initiated oxidative weathering long after debris deposition.
例句.中文: 研究者断言，流体可能通过那些微裂隙到达碎屑处，并在碎屑沉积很久之后引发氧化风化。

例句.英文: The study also found that the vapor’s collapse temperature was “nearly independent of material and fluid properties, contrary to previous theories.” .
例句.中文: 研究还发现，蒸气的坍缩温度「几乎与材料和流体性质无关，与先前理论相悖」。

义项: 名词 描绘特定人物的作品（his portraits of notable figures 他为知名人物所作的肖像）
名词 (引申义) （文字上的）生动描绘（a portrait of an era 一个时代的写照）

例句.英文: British painter Peter Edwards is known for his portraits of notable figures in different fields, from poet Wendy Cope to mathematician Christopher Zeeman.
例句.中文: 英国画家彼得·爱德华兹以绘制各领域知名人物的肖像著称，从诗人温迪·科普到数学家克里斯托弗·齐曼。

例句.英文: Among its thousands of portraits of well-known figures from British history, London’s National Portrait Gallery (NPG) includes self-portraits by noteworthy British artists, including one of J.M.W.
例句.中文: 在数千幅英国历史名人肖像中，伦敦国家肖像馆（NPG）也收藏了知名英国艺术家的自画像，其中包括 J.M.W. 特纳的一幅。

义项: 名词 拉紧的状态或心理上的紧绷（greater tension in the tongue 舌部更大的张力）
名词 (引申义) （局势、关系的）紧张（rising tension 紧张加剧）

例句.英文: In the Mexican dialect of Spanish, the consonant s is pronounced with greater tension in the tongue than it is in Castilian, the dominant dialect in Spain, resulting in a sharper sound.
例句.中文: 在墨西哥西班牙语中，辅音 s 发音时舌部张力大于西班牙主导方言卡斯蒂利亚语，因而……

例句.英文: Apichatpong describes his films as sleep inducing, which might suggest that they bore their audiences, but boredom does not necessarily cause sleep: in the absence of a goal to which one attaches attention and interest, the tension of boredom can be anxiety inducing rather than soporific.
例句.中文: 阿彼察邦称自己的电影能催眠，这似乎暗示它们令观众无聊；但无聊未必导致入睡——当没有一个让人投放注意与兴趣的目标时，无聊的张力反而使人焦躁，而非昏昏欲睡。

义项: 名词 整体未被分割或损毁的状态（Community Integrity 群落完整性）
名词 (引申义) 正直、诚实（personal integrity 个人操守）

例句.英文: To assess how birds respond to shoreline hardening and other landscape alterations, Diann Prosser et al. used a tool known as the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity to survey bird communities consisting of sixty-four species, including the tundra swan and the great blue heron, in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast.
例句.中文: 为评估鸟类如何回应岸线硬化及其他景观改变，Diann Prosser 等人使用了一个名为「水鸟群落完整性指数」的工具。

例句.英文: To evaluate the responses of local waterbird species, including the osprey, to landscape alterations, the researchers utilized the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a low score corresponds to low community integrity.
例句.中文: 为评估当地水禽物种（包括鱼鹰）对景观改变的响应，研究者使用了水禽群落完整性指数（IWCI，得分越低群落完整性越低）。

义项: 名词 人工开凿的通航水道（filled with canals 运河纵横）
名词 (引申义) 管道、通道（the ear canal 耳道）

例句.英文: Venice is an Italian city filled with canals, and boats are the primary form of transportation there.
例句.中文: 威尼斯是一座运河纵横的意大利城市，船只是当地主要的交通方式。

例句.英文: Ever Given, an international shipping container vessel, became lodged in Egypt's Suez Canal, a major shipping route between Europe and Asia.
例句.中文: 国际集装箱货轮「长赐号」搁浅于埃及苏伊士运河——欧亚之间的航运要道。

义项: 名词 具有特定性质的实体材料（find substances with prespecified characteristics 寻找具备预设特性的物质）
名词 (引申义) 实质、要旨（a matter of substance 实质性问题）

例句.英文: Additionally, these assessment-based methods lack efficient ways to find substances with prespecified characteristics.
例句.中文: 此外，这些基于评估的方法缺乏高效途径来寻找具备预设特性的物质。

例句.英文: These sticky substances also help trees retain water that is needed for them to survive.
例句.中文: 这些黏性物质还能帮助树木留存生存所需的水分。

义项: 名词 拥有并可带来价值的资源（among their assets 在其资产之列）
名词 (引申义) 优点、有利条件（a great asset 一大优势）

例句.英文: Companies involved in petroleum extraction include drilling equipment among their assets.
例句.中文: 从事石油开采的企业，其资产中包括钻探设备。

例句.英文: Box modeling, used by digital artists to develop 3D assets for video games, yields objects with precise mathematical proportions.
例句.中文: 数字艺术家为电子游戏开发 3D 资产所用的盒子建模法，可产出具有精确数学比例的物体。

义项: 动词 为某事提供理由（warrant attention 值得关注）
名词 授权令、搜查令（a search warrant 搜查令）

例句.英文: Prospero has stated that Miranda likely does not remember anything other than her life on the island. MIRANDA: Tis far off,And rather like a dream than an assurance That my remembrance warrants.
例句.中文: 普洛斯彼罗已说明，米兰达很可能除了岛上生活之外什么都不记得了。

义项: 名词 自然堆积形成的物质层（mineral deposits 矿物沉积）
名词 (引申义) 定金、押金；动词「存放、沉积」

例句.英文: Studying meteorites recovered on Earth to infer details about hypersaline water from mineral deposits left after evaporation is possible in theory, but exposure to Earth's atmosphere has probably changed or destroyed most of those deposits.
例句.中文: 从理论上说，可以通过研究在地球上回收的陨石，来推断蒸发后留下的矿物沉积中关于高盐水的信息，但暴露于地球环境……

例句.英文: An anthropologist is recording the metal contents of various historical deposits of valuables, called hoards, found in Ireland and Northern Ireland.
例句.中文: 一位人类学家正在记录爱尔兰与北爱尔兰各处珍贵物品窖藏的金属含量。

义项: 形容词 化学性质极稳定的（noble gases 惰性气体）
形容词 (引申义) 高贵的、崇高的（a noble cause 崇高的事业）

例句.英文: The earliest experiment with Fl revealed properties associated with noble gases, while a second experiment found that Fl acts like a volatile metal.
例句.中文: 最早关于 Fl 的实验发现了与惰性气体相关的性质，而第二项实验则发现 Fl 表现得像一种易挥发的金属。

例句.英文: When Yakushev, Lens, et al. studied interactions between Fl and gold surfaces, they found that Fl is less reactive than the volatile metal mercury but is more reactive than the noble gas radon.
例句.中文: Yakushev、Lens 等人研究 Fl 与金表面的相互作用时发现：Fl 的反应性低于易挥发的汞，却高于惰性气体氡。

义项: 形容词 不偏向任何一方（neutral wording 中立的措辞）
形容词 中性的（pH 7）；物理义「不带电的」

例句.英文: To test whether anger can contribute to problem-solving abilities, researcher Heather Lench led an experiment in which participants were randomly assigned to view images designed to create an emotional condition—either neutral or one of anger, amusement, desire, or sadness.
例句.中文: 为检验愤怒是否有助于解决问题，研究者 Heather Lench 主持了一项实验，参与者被随机分配观看不同图片。

例句.英文: Meanwhile, in a control group, all individuals (from all three species) resumed neutral behavior in less than one-tenth of a second after the simulated attack.
例句.中文: 与此同时，在对照组中，所有个体（三个物种皆有）在模拟攻击后不到十分之一秒内便恢复了中性状态。

义项: 名词 对作品复制与传播的专有权利（a book's copyright expires 一本书的版权到期）
[辨析] 与 patent（专利）不同，copyright 保护表达形式而非技术方案

例句.英文: When a book's copyright expires, the book enters the public domain and can be legally reproduced by anyone..
例句.中文: 当一本书的版权到期后，该书进入公有领域，任何人都可合法复制。

例句.英文: A copyright prevents a book's contents from being reproduced (published) without permission from the copyright holder..
例句.中文: 版权防止书籍内容未经版权持有者许可被复制（出版）。

义项: 名词 系统性的提问与查证（a scientific inquiry 科学探究）
[辨析] 美式拼写 inquiry，英式亦可 enquiry；动词 inquire 询问

例句.英文: There are three basic steps you should follow when planning a scientific inquiry.
例句.中文: 规划一项科学探究时，应遵循三个基本步骤。

义项: 名词 帝国的最高统治者（the emperor penguin 帝企鹅）
[词族] empire 帝国；imperial 帝国的

例句.英文: Moreover, they estimated that one of the two penguin species was more than three times the size of the emperor penguin, which is the largest penguin species that exists today.
例句.中文: 此外，他们估计这两个企鹅物种之一，体型是现存最大的企鹅物种——帝企鹅——的三倍以上。

例句.英文: The adult emperor moth appears brown and orange with multiple eyespots as a result of pigmented scales that cover its wings and body.
例句.中文: 帝王蛾成虫呈棕、橙两色并带多个眼斑，这是覆盖其翅与身体的色素鳞片所致。

义项: 名词 负责看护某人或某物者（guardian of dreams 梦的守护者）
名词 监护人

例句.英文: The bleak fields are asleep,My heart alone wakes;The evening in the harbour Down his red sails takes. Night, guardian of dreams,Now wanders through the land;The moon, a lily white,Blossoms within her hand.
例句.中文: 荒凉的田野沉睡，唯有我的心醒着；黄昏在港湾收拢它红色的帆。夜，梦的守护者，如今漫行于大地之上。

例句.英文: The text is an excerpt from a letter by Lady Howard to Evelina’s guardian, Reverend Villars, in which Lady Howard discusses an upcoming trip to London planned by her daughter Mrs.
例句.中文: 本文摘自霍华德夫人写给伊芙莉娜监护人维拉斯牧师的信，信中谈到她女儿计划的一次伦敦之行。

义项: 形容词 指西方艺术音乐传统（classical music 古典音乐）
形容词 (引申义) （学科）经典的、正统的（classical mechanics 经典力学）

例句.英文: For instance, his waltz "Pleasant Moments" and his opera Treemonisha skillfully blend ragtime and classical music.
例句.中文: 例如，他的圆舞曲《欢乐时光》与歌剧《特里莫尼莎》巧妙融合了拉格泰姆与古典音乐。

例句.英文: Reena Esmail’s classical composition “Summitless Mountains” incorporates a raag, a melodic framework used in Hindustani classical music, called Raag Chandrakouns.
例句.中文: Reena Esmail 的古典乐作品《无巅之山》融入了一支拉格——印度斯坦古典音乐使用的旋律框架——名为 Raag Chandrakouns。

义项: 形容词 双方对等发生的（mutual attraction 相互吸引）
[辨析] mutual 强调双向；common 强调共享（common interest 共同利益）

例句.英文: A team of researchers therefore hypothesized that electrostatic attraction (mutual attraction between objects with opposite charges) might enhance pollen transmission between plants and their pollinator species.
例句.中文: 因此，一组研究者提出假设：静电吸引（带相反电荷物体之间的相互吸引）可能增强花粉的传递。

例句.英文: Afterward with mutual hatred; he in disgust, they in mistrust.
例句.中文: 此后彼此仇视：他心怀嫌恶，她们满怀疑忌。

义项: 名词 用于演奏音乐的器具（an instrument maker 乐器制作师）
名词 (引申义) 工具、手段；仪器（a measuring instrument 测量仪器）

例句.英文: Antonio Stradivari (1644-1737) was an Italian instrument maker. ·He made about 1,000 violins in his lifetime. ·Musicians prize his Stradivari us violins for their famed sound quality ·The Ole Bull Stradivari us is named for former owner Ole Bull, a Norwegian violinist.
例句.中文: 安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里（1644—1737）是意大利的乐器制作师。

例句.英文: Ningyo joruri is a form of theater that was popular in eighteenth-century Japan and that unites puppetry with playing of the shamisen, a stringed musical instrument.
例句.中文: 人形净琉璃是十八世纪日本盛行的戏剧形式，把木偶戏与三味线（弦乐器）演奏融为一体。

义项: 名词 光按波长展开形成的色带（the emission spectrum 发射光谱）
名词 (引申义) 范围、谱系（a spectrum of opinion 意见的光谱）

例句.英文: This collection of wavelengths is known as the emission spectrum of the element.
例句.中文: 这一组波长被称为该元素的发射光谱。

例句.英文: The green portion of the visible spectrum is made up of light with wavelengths of 500–570 nm.
例句.中文: 可见光谱的绿色部分由波长 500-570 纳米的光构成。
